bullets: Today and Habits are now a two-column grid of big tiles instead of a list — tap anywhere on a tile to check the habit off, tap again to undo. Habits you track by number, like push-ups, open a quick counter pre-filled to your target.
To do and Done are two tabs over the same grid, so the whole day fits on one screen, and every tile carries a seven-day strip plus a one-tap History button.
Today now has Today’s plan and Tomorrow’s plan buttons, so you can write or edit a daily brief at any hour — and every screen starts below the status bar instead of underneath it.
Habit icons are now STOA's own hand-drawn set — bold, filled shapes with real depth, replacing the generic outline symbols.
Twice as many to choose from: 40 icons grouped by Movement, Nourishment, Rest, Mind, Creative and more, including symbols that suit habits you're trying to avoid.
The icon picker now previews each choice in your habit's actual colour, so what you pick is what you get.
A new look for Today and Habits: a bold display typeface for headlines, and a soft colour wash behind the top of each screen.
Habit icons now have depth — a gradient in the habit's own colour instead of a flat circle.
Today's header shows the day at a glance, with habits done, longest streak and your planned wake time.
Plan tomorrow in the evening: wake time, training, warm-up and your three must-wins, in one short form on Today.
The next morning, Today opens with your Daily Brief — a designed card built from what you wrote the night before, saveable to Photos in one tap.
Days you don't plan simply carry on as normal — no empty brief, nothing to dismiss.
Every habit now has a contribution grid on its detail screen — months of history as dense coloured squares, in that habit's own colour. Tap any square to see or fix that day.
Brighter, more confident colours across the whole app, tuned to look right in both light and dark mode.
The mood you log after a check-in now has its own colour per face, and quietly stops asking on habits you never rate.
Habits-focused mode: the app now centres on Habits, Today, Journal and Analytics. Tasks and Planning are hidden — nothing is deleted, and one switch in Settings brings them back exactly as they were.
Today now leads with the one habit that's actually slipping, showing plainly how many of its recent scheduled days were missed.
New Habit fields setting: choose which fields appear on the habit form and detail view, and drag them into the order you want.
New Sleep section in Analytics — log your bedtime and wake time for any day, including past ones, and see hours slept calculated automatically.
See your sleep as a table and two charts: bedtime vs. wake time night to night, and hours slept per day.
Tapping any habit now shows this week's completion pattern as icon circles, with an option to expand to the full month.
Tap any day's circle to log or correct it — including entering a number for habits you track by value, on any past day, not just today.
Fixed a bug where an older habit could cause the whole app to fail to open, showing a blank screen.
If something ever does go wrong now, the app will show a real error message with a way to recover, instead of just going blank.
Catch up on habits you forgot to log for the last week — mark them done or not done for that specific day, right from the Habits tab.
Streaks now correctly reflect a day you backdated, instead of staying broken.
Today has a new look: a friendly greeting, one combined list of what's left for the day, and a calmer, less cluttered layout.
Completed tasks now join completed habits in the "Done today" tray.
Pick a custom icon for any habit — or leave it to automatically match its life domain. Completed habits now show up as colorful icon bubbles you can undo with one tap.
Habits and tasks linked to a day's plan now show their real color and icon, matching how they look everywhere else in the app.
The update banner now shows what changed before you tap Refresh.
New Pro Settings screen to customize each life domain and project's color and icon.
Photo attachments on habit check-ins, tasks, and journal entries — compressed automatically before saving.
Full app backup and restore from Settings, including photos.
A Data Integrity Check in Settings to find and fix orphaned records.
Voice input, a quick-add shortcut, and search across your habits, tasks, and journal.
Smarter reminders: quiet hours, a follow-up nudge, and a morning digest.
Calendar export for critical reminders, and CSV export of a habit’s history.
